prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wedding invitation portrait locket and responsive gallery crop
Primary request: Create an obviously fictional demo wedding portrait of the couple Amara and Julian at an elegant evening garden wedding.
Scene/backdrop: shadowed conservatory garden at blue hour with restrained warm champagne bokeh, deep oxblood foliage tones, no readable signage.
Subject: the same two fictional adults who will recur in later gallery images; bride with warm medium-olive skin, dark brown hair in a low sculptural bun, expressive brown eyes, natural makeup, wearing an ivory silk wedding dress with a clean neckline; groom with light olive skin, wavy dark brown hair, gentle stubble, wearing a perfectly tailored black tuxedo, white shirt, and black bow tie. They stand close, turned slightly toward one another, quietly intimate rather than posed for an advertisement.
Style/medium: cinematic natural editorial wedding photography, photorealistic, realistic skin pores and fine hair, honest fabric grain, subtle film response, luxury magazine restraint.
Composition/framing: vertical 4:5-feeling portrait, chest-up two-shot, both faces fully visible and centered within a generous square-safe crop for an oval locket; hands and arms remain entirely out of frame; no objects crossing faces.
Lighting/mood: intimate evening light, soft directional champagne key light with cool blue-hour separation, deep but readable shadows.
Color palette: black cherry, oxblood, muted mauve, ivory, antique champagne; controlled saturation and natural skin color.
Constraints: unmistakably a photographic demo image rather than documentary evidence; anatomically natural; realistic skin and fabric; no text, no logo, no watermark, no phone, no visible hands, no extra people.
Avoid: bridal catalog stiffness, plastic skin, glamour retouching, rose-gold haze, rustic styling, daytime light, artificial lens flare, painterly treatment, CGI, extra fingers, cropped faces.
